ideas.idea: Add address, url, openingHours and sameAs to the Dentist JSON-LD on /contact
ideas.why: The block currently has only name and telephone, while the page shows an address, so adding these labels real facts for machines.

ideas.idea: Back up or drop the 'Trusted by thousands of local patients' claim on the home page
ideas.why: The claim at index.njk:7 has no supporting numbers, reviews or links, so adding evidence gives readers and AI tools something to cite.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with qualifications and experience on /team, optionally with their own pages
ideas.why: The team page only says 'decades of experience between them' and names no one, which is the information visitors come for.

ideas.idea: Show actual prices or a price list on /services
ideas.why: The page says 'Our prices are simple and clear' but lists no prices.

ideas.idea: Explain each treatment or give it its own page
ideas.why: The four treatments are bare list items with no detail on what is involved, how long it takes or who it suits.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours, parking and emergency instructions as text on /contact
ideas.why: The page has only a phone number and street address, and the home page promises emergency appointments.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap, ideally generated by Eleventy
ideas.why: The sitemap has only four URLs, so lastmod adds little, and this applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags and Organization/WebSite structured data in base.njk
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site; Open Graph affects link previews, not discoverability.
This applies to any site and does little for discovery or understanding.

ideas.idea: Link from Services to Contact and Team, so pages link to each other
ideas.why: The navigation already links all four pages on every page, so extra in-page links add very little.
